description.narrative:
The Project is expected to create micro-entrepreneurship opportunities for creative entrepreneurs (content creators) in India by supporting the scaling up of a non-music audio platform that harnesses content from creative auto-entrepreneurs to serve listeners. Such outcomes come against the background of limited work opportunities for skilled, creative individuals in India. They have the potential to create impact by providing improved livelihoods for creators, through income generation. Further, the scaling up of the platform is associated with gender-specific targets that will result in the onboarding of more women creative entrepreneurs.
The Project also has several benefits in the form of educational and inspirational content which will lead to upward socio-economic mobility of the largely young population in India. The fact that the platform encourages content in regional languages would aid in reaching vast swathes of population beyond just the metro and tier 1 cities.
The main sources of expected Market Creation outcomes involve sustaining linkages in the online audio industry in India by enabling the mobility of content creators and listeners across non-music audio streaming platforms through capacity building. As part of its onboarding process, the Company provides training to content creators and also helps listeners discover the value of non-music audio content. Its successful scale-up would result in the onboarding of new content creators and listeners who would leverage the capacity they acquire with the Company to participate in other online audio streaming platforms, thereby supporting the growth of the online audio industry and the broader creator economy.

The proposed Project is an equity investment of up to US$10 million in Mebigo Labs Private Limited (Kuku FM or the Company), a private limited company domiciled in India. Kuku FM is one of Indias largest digital audio platforms that offers non-music, regional audio content across audiobooks, original series, book summaries, podcasts, and courses focused on non-fiction self-learning content. The content is long-form in nature, broken into bite-sized, audio-only, capsular episodes of 10-15 minutes each like an episodic television show. The platform primarily caters to users in Tier-II and beyond cities in India across semi-urban and rural segments. As of March 2023, the Company had an active paid subscriber base of 2.7 million users.
